transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I hope this doesn’t sound dramatic. I’m here because for a few months I’ve been feeling like people aren’t really understanding what’s been going on. There have been these little things, like errors with billing at work, or someone at church suddenly acting strange toward me, and I know it connects back to my husband’s family.

They’re not doing it openly, exactly… it’s more quiet, messing with our money and our reputation. Other people will pull up records and say they don’t see it, but I know how it all ties together. I just want someone to take it seriously, if that makes sense.
Do you feel that people are acting against you or targeting you in some way without openly showing it?

Yes… I mean, I don’t want to sound like I’m accusing everyone or making a big scene, but yes, it does feel that way.

For months I’ve been trying to get people to understand that my husband’s family is quietly doing things—messing with our money, and with how people see us. Like little billing errors showing up at work, or someone at church suddenly acting strange toward me. And when people pull up records, they say they don’t see anything, but… I know it all ties back to them somehow. I hope that makes sense.
Do you believe that your husband’s family is working together in a secret way to harm you or plot against you?

I… I don’t want to say “plot,” exactly, because that sounds so harsh. But yes, I do believe they’re working together in a quiet way.

For months I’ve been trying to get people to understand that my husband’s family is messing with our money and our good name. Like little billing errors showing up at work, or people at church acting funny toward me. And even when someone pulls records and says they don’t see anything, I know it ties back to them somehow. I’m not trying to make trouble… I just want someone to see what I’m seeing.
Do you feel that different people are working together or coordinating in some way to carry out these actions against you?

Yes… I think so. I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is, or like I’m blaming everyone, but it feels coordinated.

I’m here because for months now I’ve been trying to get people to understand that my husband’s family is quietly messing with our money and our good name. Like when little billing errors show up at work, or someone at church suddenly acts funny toward me… and no matter what records anyone pulls up, I know it ties back to them. Does that make sense?
Do you feel that people are intentionally deceiving you or denying the truth when they tell you they don’t see any evidence of what you’re experiencing?

I don’t want to say people are lying exactly… that sounds awful. But when they tell me they don’t see anything, it feels like they’re just not admitting what’s there.

I mean, I’ve been trying for months to explain that my husband’s family is quietly interfering with our money and our reputation. Like those little billing errors at work, or the way someone at church will suddenly act strange toward me. And then people pull records and say, “Nothing’s there,” but… I still know it ties back to them somehow.

I’m not trying to be difficult. I just need someone to understand what I’m seeing.
Have you ever experienced any thoughts or beliefs that others have told you aren’t true, but you still feel deep down that they are?

Yes… I guess that would be fair to say. I don’t want to sound stubborn or like I think I know better than everyone, but there are things people keep telling me aren’t happening, and I still feel like they are.

I’m here because I’ve been trying for months to get people to understand that my husband’s family is quietly interfering with our money and our good name. Like little billing errors showing up at work, or someone at church acting funny toward me all of a sudden. And even when people pull records and say they don’t see anything, deep down I still know it ties back to them somehow.

I know that may sound… I don’t know, maybe too much. But that’s honestly how it feels to me.

Have there been times when you experienced things like hearing voices that others don’t hear, seeing things that aren’t there, or feeling like your thoughts are being controlled or shared without your consent?

No… I don’t think so. Not like voices or seeing things, anyway. I mean, I get worried and I notice things, but I’m not hearing someone talking when nobody’s there.

And thoughts being controlled or shared… no, I wouldn’t say that. I know how that sounds, and I don’t want to make this seem like something it isn’t. I just feel like there are things happening around me that people aren’t recognizing. Is that… is that what you mean?
Have you ever had any unusual beliefs that you know might sound strange to others, like thoughts that something is affecting your body or mind in a very unusual or impossible way?

Not in the way of, um… something affecting my body or controlling my mind. I don’t think that’s what’s happening.

It’s more… I know this may sound strange, and I’m sorry if I’m not explaining it right, but I’ve been trying for months to get people to understand that my husband’s family is quietly messing with our money and our good name. Like small billing errors showing up at work, or someone at church suddenly acting funny toward me. Other people say the records don’t show anything, but to me it still feels connected back to them.

Does that answer what you mean?

Even though others have shown you that there’s no proof in the records, do you still feel certain that your husband’s family is behind these things, and does that belief feel completely true to you no matter what others say?

Yes… I mean, I know people keep saying there isn’t proof, and I’m trying not to be difficult about it. I don’t want to seem like I’m accusing people for no reason.

But deep down, yes, it does feel true to me. For months I’ve been trying to get people to understand that my husband’s family is quietly messing with our money and our reputation. The little billing errors at work, people at church suddenly acting strange toward me… even when someone pulls up records and says there’s nothing there, I still feel like it all ties back to them somehow.

I know that probably sounds bad, or like I’m not listening. I am listening. I just… I can’t make myself not know what I know.
